{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the 'revenue' column data type and values
print("Revenue column data type:", sales_df['revenue'].dtype)
print("Unique revenue values:", sales_df['revenue'].unique())

# Convert revenue from string to numeric, handling non-numeric entries
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any invalid conversions
print("Number of invalid revenue entries:", sales_df['revenue'].isnull().sum())

# Display the first few rows after conversion
sales_df.head()"}
